reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Sha-Shib College of Technology, Sha- Shib Group of Institutions.

review_content.Placements: Our campus is home to companies like Oracle, IBM, and HCL Technology, among many others. Students with top AI skills are given projects during breaks and those who complete them are hired directly from campus. The salary package offered ranges from 7 LPA - 10 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms are amazing and SIRTE building, which is right next to ours doesn't even have half the facilities that we have. We are proud of the fact that our building has its own library, its own canteen, and its own student activity corners. Grounds and all are common and are shared by both SIRT and SIRTE students. Even the annual fest, SAGE Utsav, is common for both colleges.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: My overall experience in Sha-Shib institution.

review_content.Placements: Placement provided in this institution is not a good experience because it is not a very good package offer by the top company. Overall, an average package is around 1.5 LPA. Internship facilities are not available here. Alumni are very nice; they help there juniors in all possible ways. There is a very good network of friendships between juniors and seniors; they all share a good bond among them.
review_content.Infrastructure: A good campus life is a completely different world with a calm and beautiful climate. Many workshops are conducted with a gender ratio of 3:1 boy-girl ratio; you can't expect any girls in mechanical though. Yes, rooms are well furnished with a double cot, beds, a table chair, and a Wi-Fi connection 24/7, and bathrooms are also well maintained with everyday cleaning. However, rooms are cleaned every week once, so you have to keep them till the end of the week. And food in mess is home-cooked.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: No facilities, and no support for placement.

review_content.Placements: Passing percentage is average. No Placement cell is available in the college. Average package is 3 to 4 lacs. Last year, one company visited.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied. There are good faculty members and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Mechanical engineering has CAD/CAM, metrology, material testing, fluid mechanics, foundry and forging labs, which are equipped with modern machines. reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for CS and E and C engineering.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are good, but the hostel is average. Medical facilities are not available, but the canteen is available. Sports are not given much priority. reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of faculty members.
reviews.review_text: We have good classrooms with discipline boards and Wi-Fi. Our college has a well-built library, and we have a separate laboratory for different kinds of specialisations. We have a good quality hostel, and they provide quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good college for academically good students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities given to us are good. Infrastructure is excellent, which is a good point for our college. Labs are provided with almost all facilities. Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms are good. The hostel is given with good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with everything.
reviews.review_text: Yes, in our course or department, there are many facilities available. There is no lack of anything. reviews.review_heading: The worst college of engineering.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available everywhere in the college, good labs are here, and a good library is also good. Mobile is not connecting to Wi-Fi. Also, other networks are slow in this area. This place is like a jail for students. A lot of students D.Ed here.

reviews.review_heading: Good for knowledge gain.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility, labs are good, and the hostel facility is also good. Library is also the best. A bus facility is also there. review_summary.college_name: Cochin College of Engineering and Technology, Malappuram Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: This college is not good for your higher education.

content.Placements: Our seniors have backlogs, and none of the students gets placements from Cochin College of Engineering. The pass percentage in the previous year was just 11%. Salary packages are not offered in our college, so we have to work hard to get placed.
content.Infrastructure: I don't have any idea about the college hostel. But the campus is just like a tuition centre as only theory classes are conducted. The lab doesn't work properly, and there are old machines.
content.Faculty: Teachers here don't have any experience on how to handle students. Every semester, old teachers are leaving, and new teachers are joining. New teachers join here without experience. So they don't have any idea about the college and the students. However, some teachers teach well, but they don't get their salaries. So they start teaching a subject and stop teaching at half of the subject. None of the students can get the proper education from our college. Our college offering high education facilities with low fees, but none of the students gets the proper education according to their fees. One class has 10 students, and 10 students have 10 different fee structures. Teachers don't get their salaries as they are pending from past 6months.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The college is not good at providing infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Less than 10% of the students in our course got placed. They offer average salary packages.
content.Infrastructure: In our department, labs, classrooms, and a library are provided to the students. The quality food is available in the mess. In addition to shared kitchen facilities, washing machines and clothes dryers are often provided with an addition of hot water and cold water facilities.
content.Faculty: The teaching quality is very bad, and it is not understandable for students. They are not qualified. Their voice is not clear, and the teaching method is also not understandable. The college teachers do not help in the exam or anything.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The college provides one of the better platforms if you are focusing on mechatronics engineering.

content.Placements: There is a placement cell available in the college. A few students were placed through campus placements last year. Most of them were offered a salary of Rs. 40,000-50,000 per month depending on their branches. The first batch of KTU will complete their course this year. The first batch of mechatronics will also get passed out this year. More details about placements will be known after this year.
content.Infrastructure: The college has spread over a lot of acres, but we have only a few buildings here. There are only 5 blocks, and 2 of them are for only labs, and the two blocks are available to conduct classes. One of the buildings is allocated for the canteen. The off-road track has been set on the campus itself for one of the events conducted during the previous technical fest.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Biomedical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Staff are of very good quality.

content.Placements: I am from the department of biomedical engineering. About 70% of students are placed in the department every year. The highest package is about 3 LPA. Many top recruiting companies visit our course, and most of our students are attending the placements. Top roles like testing, manager, etc., are offered.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure and facilities are good, and the campus has a green environment. Infrastructure like labs and library is fully equipped with air conditioners. The hostel facilities are average and the food is better than average. Sports are conducted once a year.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Food Technology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Worth to join in this college.

content.Placements: No placements yet for the food technology, we are the 2nd batch of this course in our college. But not many food companies visit our college. Students are looking for internships too. But, the food technology students have many scopes in the future, so no need to worry.
content.Infrastructure: The canteen and hostel are average but it is worth of cost. The cricket ground is also there. Hostelers may play in the evening time, there is a separate hostel for boys and girls with security. They serve both non-veg and veg. Good labs are available, but there is no- wife on the campus.

individual_reviews.title: Placements are poor. Infrastructure was good and satisfactory teachers.

content.Placements: The intake for B.Tech students was around 450 out of which around 8-10% of the students got placed. The highest salary package offered was around 3 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 2.4 LPA. The average salary package offered was around 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Wipro, HCL, Cognizant, etc., and hired around 2 to 3 students each. Top roles offered were testers, technical analyst, etc. The college doesn't assist in getting an internship. You have to search on your own.

There is a cricket ground, football and basketball court on the campus. The college has a library, which is quite good and spacious. Food provided in the canteen is eatable. There are separate campus hostels for boys and girls. Rooms are also quite decent.

The campus is too good to study and enjoy.

reviews.review_heading: The college has an awesome infrastructure, good teachers, but placements were not provided in 2019.
reviews.review_text: The college has an awesome infrastructure and a very good environment to study. Mechanical laboratories are well-facilitated. The library is very good, and lots of knowledgeable books are available. I suggest not to prefer a hostel in our college. There is no proper quality of food, and the power supply is very bad.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, but it provides less knowledge for the students.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides van facility from different places in the district. It provides computer labs with Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are equipped with the projector. Smart classrooms are also available. Quality of the food served in the hostel mess is average. There is a canteen on the campus in which all the stationery items are also available. Medical facilities are not available. It conducts sports and games once a year.

reviews.review_heading: This college is not worthy to join because of its management and faculty.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi facility on the campus. Classrooms are not well furnished. Even the lab equipment doesn't work properly. The college doesn't conduct any games. If students are willing to play games presenting our college, the authority will not even allow them to do so. Food served in the canteen and mess doesn't have any quality. In the name of free hostel facility, they are attracting middle-class people to join this college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Gokula Krishna College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Gokula Krishna College of Engineering is good, but the maintenance was not good. There are three separate blocks for engineering, diploma, and pharmacy, but the diploma block is closed due to the lack of students in that course.

reviews.review_heading: No please. Don't get fooled by seeing the building.
reviews.review_text: 2/5 for infrastructure. The facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, medical facilities, sports and games etc. Were very poor. Labs have zero quality. Classrooms are okay. Labs are very important for mechanical engineering stream, but the management never bothered about that. Canteen is below par. Hostel is below average.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to enjoy u have to join in any college but you have to succeed in your life you hope for
reviews.review_text: The college's infrastructure is good but the labs for all branches are not good. There are no digital classrooms, the sports were conducted once in 2 or 3 years and there is no scope for sports in this college. The classrooms were just good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi connection is mainly in the labs and for the department HODs. There is no Wi-Fi connection in classrooms. There is a vast library with 25000 volumes of books but there are no medical facilities in the college. Sports are conducted for yearly once and there will be a grand celebration for a day. The food in the canteen also good.

It’s a nice college with all the lab facilities and faculty. Less curricular activities, more of teaching and classes. Practical experience is not exist. I mean more of bookish knowledge. reviews.review_heading: It is decent, but there are better colleges than it.

reviews.review_heading: In my batch, only a few members got placed, so that was the satisfaction.
reviews.review_text: The hostel building was nice with tasty food. Wi-Fi, hot water, beds were available. Rooms were clean. The warden was very strict. We had taken permission from the warden to go outside for needed goods.
